system.description:
Animals are unusually drawn to you, although you can’t speak to them you can communicate on a limited level based on body language and tone.

● Beast Affinity: One specifictype of animal is affected (i.e.Crows).

●● Beast Kinship: One specificgroup of animals is affected (i.e. Birds).

●●● Beast Mastery: All natural animals are affected.

●●●●● Unnatural Beast Mastery: Even supernatural animals are affected by your aura, although it only covers non-sapient creatures.
